description: Turn live SERP intent into a production-ready content brief for writers and coding agents. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

audience.description: Intended reader or buyer group in plain language; do not include unnecessary personal data. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

brand_voice.description: Writing voice to use for the content recommendations. Type: String. Accepted values: "neutral", "expert", "friendly", "bold", "technical". Default: "expert".

brief_depth.description: Amount of implementation detail requested in the content brief. Type: String. Accepted values: "standard", "detailed". Default: "standard".

device.description: Device search-result profile used for the analysis. Type: String. Accepted values: "desktop", "mobile". Default: "desktop".

include_serp_outline.description: Include a search-result-informed page outline in the brief when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

keyword.description: Search keyword or phrase to analyze for this workflow. Type: String. Required.

language.description: Supported search language code, for example en for English. Type: String. Default: "en".

location.description: Supported geographic search-market name, for example United States; this is not a coordinate pair. Type: String. Default: "United States".

page_type.description: Page format or classification for this record; select one of the accepted values. Type: String. Accepted values: "auto", "blog_post", "landing_page", "comparison_page", "guide", "tool_page". Default: "auto".

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Your target brand, domain or URL used to scope this workflow; supply the entity you want assessed. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

name: agentseo_content_brief
title: AgentSEO Content Brief
